items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...and Kendall. [INTERVIEWEE] Them boys were all dead.

ctx.x: I don't believe it. Nick wasn't playing when the Biloxi band. Yeah.
That's the Biloxi band, no. You got Martin Korn, you got Denny Stevens, and two coachmans, and Kendall.
